review_scope: Independent raw-JSON/numeric evidence audit only; no arithmetic benchmark or source edits

numeric_policy.integer_parser: Tokenize JSON before JSON.parse; large integer literals remain exact decimal strings. All timestamp/work equations use BigInt.
numeric_policy.wins: Compare exact elapsed_A*operations_B with elapsed_B*operations_A; includes actual jobs,1024steps and differing mode lane counts.
numeric_policy.floating_point: Recompute binary64 elapsed/jobs, elapsed/operations and same-round ratios; tolerance 5e-13*max(1,abs(a),abs(b)) against published values.
numeric_policy.statistics: All eight measured region means retained. Min/median/max/arithmetic mean independently recomputed; weighted pooled elapsed/work labelled separately. Paired median is median of eight same-round ratios, not ratio of medians.

frozen_binding.scope: All17 current exact source/object/library/binary files match preperformance freeze; build commands retained externally, not rerun by this numeric audit.

measurement_environment_supplement.known: All owned builds, arithmetic tests, smokes, synthetic tests and substantive disassembly collection finished before full timing; root JSON replay and byte/source freeze preceded both series.
measurement_environment_supplement.uncertainty: Codegen worker's final lightweight jq/sha256sum/xxd artifact check has no retained exact UTC timestamp. Worker cannot establish completion before23:14:38; receipt-of-pause ordering is not wall-clock proof. Brief metadata-check overlap cannot be excluded.
measurement_environment_supplement.scope: No competing owned arithmetic benchmark, compiler or test was launched. Report finalization and MCP/background services remain potential small noise; frequency/thermals/SMT already uncontrolled. Retain every raw sample and do not claim isolated causal cycles or robust1percent advantage.
measurement_environment_supplement.report_rework: Only final prose sentence corrected chronology: rawJSON independently replayed before timing, prose reviewed after both series. No arithmetic/source/JSON/binary changes.

smoke_identity_only.fields_checked: Corpus descriptor, exact final128-byte outputs/checksums and every cell's trace count/hash/zero/one receipts. No smoke timings read into any P6 numeric comparison.

limitations: Two finite canonical field multiply/square series on one frozen native GCC profile; no production integration, scalar/upper-layer, novelty, world-record or CT claim.
Every job includes state initialization,1024 canonical steps per lane and full128byte serialization/padding; allocation, corpus generation and validation are outside timing.
API/direct ASM and inline/outlined row boundaries alter optimizer visibility, caller/callee state and materialization as well as calls. No ratio is an isolated call-instruction cost.

Output canonicality/padding/FNV are audited from all128byte records. Internal raw-limb correctness and each-step trace equality remain independent native C++ qualification receipts, not JavaScript field-arithmetic tests.

The complete24,704byte deterministic corpus is independently regenerated in untimed JS BigInt, including unused raw512 bytes, and compared by seed bytes/full FNV/hash receipts. Timed arrays are not archived individually; C++ preservation receipts cover each actual word.
Four full trace hashes and no-zero/one counts agree across routes, both full series and GCC/Clang smokes; intermediate trace bytes are not reconstructed as field arithmetic here.

Only the last identical job of each timed region is compared outside its clock. All calibration shorts and continuous extension prefixes remain; no restarted/discarded prefix or selective rerun enters statistics.

All later records of these full series reach200ms. Imported synthetic failure evidence is checked separately and never pooled; within-region work-cap/capped-tail execution remains statically reviewed only.

Native GCC/independent Clang qualification includes direct ASM; NO_ASM sanitizer explicitly skips47498 ASM outputs and rejects two compile-disabled wrappers. It does not instrument ASM or emulate unsupported-native hosts.
CPU4/powersave/turbo-enabled endpoints do not prove continuous frequency, no migration, thermal/SMT/background isolation or timing causality.

The final lightweight jq/sha256sum/xxd metadata-check completion has no retained timestamp; brief overlap cannot be excluded. The environment supplement overrides any broad quiet-window inference, and all raw samples remain. No competing owned compiler/arithmetic test/benchmark is reported; this audit does not independently reconstruct host activity.
No P5/historical, smoke, synthetic-clock or sanitizer timing is pooled. Comparison families overlap in observations;64 summaries/512 ratios are not independent experiments.
Full performance is GCC only; Clang correctness and smoke/codegen evidence do not constitute full Clang timing replication.
Frozen source/library/object/executable bytes and imported receipts are hashed here; compilation and emitted-code replay are not rerun. No new benchmark, build or feature edit is performed.

reproduction.runtime: Node.js; audit uses standard node:fs/node:crypto; isolated replay adapter uses node:vm. Read-only evidence analysis, no compiler/performance process invoked
reproduction.output: Writes recomputed audit JSON to stdout only; never rewrites source, evidence or audit files.
reproduction.comparison: On unchanged frozen inputs, compare status, checks, errors, sources, statistics and full program SHA256. No original raw JSON is normalized or overwritten.
reproduction.resolved_replay_issue: The initial direct-eval adapter did not replace Node process._eval, so output carried adapter-source hashes despite identical numeric checks/statistics. A wrapper-name collision also affected an initial invocation. The corrected isolated VM adapter explicitly binds process._eval to the embedded source; a separate replay verifies exact full-object equality. These were audit-invocation issues, not arithmetic or measurement failures; raw data never changed.
